# Ahmed Mahmoud

> Ahmed Mahmoud is a founder and builder based in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. He founded FirstShow, a sponsorship company for events, creators and venues across Canada, and makes websites, brands, photo, video and free web tools. He is open to work anywhere.

## About
- Location: Calgary, Alberta, Canada
- Founder of FirstShow: https://firstshow.ca
- Previously Digital Coordinator on the Calgary Zoo (Wilder Institute) communications team, 2022 to 2026: video, photography, live streams, websites and the Canto digital asset library. Led the media push for the Wild Canada opening in December 2023.
- Owner of AMZD Media since 2020: menu photography and corporate event coverage.
- Studied in the Journalism Diploma program at SAIT, 2020 to 2022.
- Certifications: Google Ads Search; HubSpot Digital Marketing, Social Media Marketing I and II, Sales Management, Revenue Operations.

## Websites he launched
- FirstShow: https://firstshow.ca
- FRAME YYC (photo and video for Calgary businesses): https://frameyyc.ca
- Bite5 (local food deals for restaurants): https://bite5.vercel.app
- Wiredeo (brief-to-shoot planning): https://www.wiredeo.com
- SteadyFile (private dated records): https://workvault-six.vercel.app
- YYC Class Finder (City of Calgary recreation programs): https://city-picks.vercel.app
